{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Create a clean version with sentinel baseline replaced by NaN
df_clean = df.copy()
df_clean['biomarker_baseline'] = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute improvement only where baseline is not missing
improvement = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']
response_mask = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].notna()

# Define response as improvement > 0
response = improvement[response_mask] > 0

# Compute response rate by sex for this improved definition
response_by_sex = df_clean[response_mask].groupby('sex')['responded'].mean()

# But we must also check if sex is balanced across arms and other covariates
# Cross-tabulate sex and arm
sex_arm_ct = pd.crosstab(df_clean['sex'], df_clean['arm'])

# Cross-tabulate sex and site
sex_site_ct = pd.crosstab(df_clean['sex'], df_clean['site'])

# Cross-tabulate sex and severity
sex_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(df_clean['sex'], df_clean['severity'])

# Check for imbalance
print(response_by_sex)
print(sex_arm_ct)
print(sex_site_ct)
print(sex_severity_ct)"}
